judgment.confirmed: At the exact D52 component commit, GET_PASTE_DATA reaches the core user-scoped clip lookup/copy without a visible in-component caller read-permission predicate.
judgment.counterexample_or_boundary: The core maps IPC caller UID to an OS account and selects that account's clip; this is isolation and can fail for invalid identity, not permission authorization. SAMgr also has a SUPPORT_PENGLAI_MODE acquisition branch omitted from D76's SELinux-focused explanation; whether it exists in a D52 product is unknown.
judgment.no_claim: No product bypass, system-wide absence of authorization, CVE cause, or product safety conclusion.
